name: priority-dev-cc-plugin
title: A plugin reads each stop of a live session with D1
outcome: With the reader switched on, each main-loop stop gets a D1 reading in a pane, and the session does not wait. The person marks each reading right or wrong, with a note, and sends the steps they choose to the session with one press. The marks stay local.
done_when: With the switch on, a main-loop stop leads to a card in the pane with the status, the priority, and each step with its content, or the abstain reason
The session takes its next prompt while the reading runs
A right, wrong, or note mark on a card is still in the store after a restart of the session
With the switch off, a stop starts no process
priority interpret --digest current labels the digest CURRENT RUN, and every other command still shows PREVIOUS RUN
On the newest card, Send with two selected steps submits one user prompt that holds the draft text of both steps, and the mark records the steps and the text
Edit puts the same draft in the prompt box and submits nothing
No prompt reaches the session without a press of Send or Edit, and an older card has no send action
The pane shows the digest summary of the newest reading above its card
abort_if: After one week of use, fewer than half of the marked readings are right, or the readings do not change which part of the prompt the engineer works on next

min_work.derived_from: 2 districts (scripts, docs), 3 ADRs (ADR-0025, ADR-0039, ADR-0045), 1 boundary rule (hooks only in named plugins), 1 uncovered path
min_work.note: Taken over from an OMP session on 2026-11-11. Stages 3 and 4 ran inline in this session, with no subagents.

epics.title: Reader: the switch, the Stop hook, the CLI flag, the store, and the install settings.
epics.outcome: With the switch on, a main-loop stop leads to a stored reading, and the session does not wait.

epics.title: Pane: one card per stop, with right, wrong, and note marks.
epics.outcome: The pane shows each stored reading, and each mark stays after a restart.

epics.title: Act: select steps on the newest card, send one draft, and draw layout C.
epics.outcome: A press of Send submits the draft of the selected steps as a user prompt, Edit puts it in the prompt box, and the mark records what was sent. The pane shows the agent summary on top.

rounds.note: Blind draft review scored 0.81 and found no survivor. It confirmed five defects, fixed in code: off drops a waiting stop, a no-digest brief shape, the reading number label, the switch state in the pane, and diagram drift. A reload can still run two readings side by side, and the contract accepts it.

The engineer asked to act on the selected steps, and to design the pane. Added epic E3, the step-to-draft table, the Send and Edit actions, and the pane layout. Renamed the priority CLI to the priority-dev CLI in prose.
The engineer chose layout C with an agent summary, and asUser true. Permission and option-pick steps became text answers. E3 is written up in contracts.md with five slices.
